desc: Ideation identified batching by initial rating as the key structural approach.
Implemented non-lazy segment tree over the difference array E (stores sumE and best = max prefix+index) supporting point updates and find_first_ge(T) descent.
Processed all N contests: p = first_index_ge(L), q = first_index_ge(R+1); applied E[p] += 1 and E[q] -= 1 (skipping empty/truncated ranges).
Answered all Q queries via O(M) prefix-sum of E to get A[x], output in order.
Validated against sample inputs 1-3 (all passed), including large-value and 500000+ rating cases.
